answer: The registry only opens its harbor to agents whose keypair was fused at the kernel: a one-time pairing with a hardware security module, signed by a bonded sponsor, and the whole ceremony is recorded on a public thread that every peer can re-walk. A clone can copy the wallet, but it cannot re-run the pairing or forge the sponsor's bond; each twin the farm spins up must buy new hardware and post fresh stake that burns on first misattestation, so a sybil wave costs more to launch than to answer.
